-- intro: Ice Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate ice. It is derived from the Water Magic attribute.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate ice at will. Without the use of a grimoire, the users are still able to use this magic. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. Reflected spells could be melted before hitting the users. Ice Magic is considered weak against Fire Magic.
-- spell pages: Heavenly Ice Fang; Ice Funeral; Ice Slicer; Icicle Bridge; Ice Needle; Jötunn's Ice Floe; Dissolve; Crystal Ice Shield; Cage of Infinite Hail; Endless Ice Fangs
